description:
Welcome to Zeqa

What is Zeqa?

Zeqa is the largest non-featured Bedrock PvP server in the world.

You can play with your friends from across the world

We have servers in North America, Europe, Asia. Australia & Africa

We have 25+ Gamemodes, Ranked Duels, FFA & Events - With a multitude of settings to customise your experience

How to join Zeqa?

1. click play its will open your Minecraft.

2. Press play then press server.

3. Find Zeqa on your server list.

4. Press Join server.
